Indeterminate — I could not reproduce the reported ad on www⁠.maxon.net/en/downloads with the reporter's own Base+Tracking baseline:⁠ the reported text "Log in and download the Maxon app." appears nowhere in the page HTML (also checked /en and /en/sale), et.maxon.net made no request among 469 HAR entries, no ad loader or overlay is present, and 30 s of waiting/scroll produced no popup. The run instruction's filter policy states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing case, so rule generation is not blocked. Closing is recommended on reproduction grounds only:⁠ the reported ad element and the reported tracker host are absent from the successfully loaded reported page in every session and page variant examined.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — amj30.com's homepage opens two self-owned modal popups (the reporter's "请务必牢记回家地址" alternate-domain notice and a "站点公告" notice) that dim the page and lock scrolling; blocking the routing script or stubbing showModal failed because the site falls back to the open attribute. Aborting reads of HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal suppressed both popups with the page left intact in the validated experiment. ## Rule `amj30.com#%#//scriptlet('abort-on-property-read', 'HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal')` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale Run instruction:⁠ the site's own advertising (self-promotion, elements in which the site promotes its own products and services) gets a rule in AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt; whether it is annoying enough to block is the maintainer's call. The reported symptom is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall and not a scam page, so none of the instruction's close-or-hand-off rules applies. No rule is closed by the maintainer rules either:⁠ the popup is neutralized with a scriptlet only because hiding is not enough (the dialogs are modal and keep the page scroll-locked), which matches the maintainers' anti-popup guidance. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/baceba8687936f419bf0892897614529a43aaccd/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt) Under the heading `!
